title: The Submarine Hatch Padlock
crime_description: The naval museum's historic decommissioned submarine had its top hatch padlocked shut with a glittery pink diary lock.

dossier.text: Surveillance footage shows a figure in a black hoodie accessing the exhibit at 10:05 PM.
The padlock used is a SparkleLock 5000, only available at Harbor City Hardware since September.
Museum security guard, Jerry Chen, reported seeing a person with a ferret in a backpack entering the exhibit at 10:40 PM.

truth_timeline.event: Suspect prepares tools and sneaks in.

lie_plan.cover_story: I was at the Harbor City Ferret Agility Club, training me own ferrets.

weak_points.claim: I was at the Harbor City Ferret Agility Club the whole time.
weak_points.planned_slip: I was just... uh... getting some... ferret treats.

weak_points.claim: The SparkleLock 5000 is available at any hardware store in the city.
weak_points.planned_slip: Oh, I just... borrowed it from a friend...

weak_points.claim: Jerry Chen was just... um... admiring the exhibits.
weak_points.planned_slip: I'm sure he would never... ferret-sit for a thief

solution_contradictions: Suspect claimed to be at the Harbor City Ferret Agility Club which directly conflicts with fact-1.
Suspect claimed the SparkleLock 5000 is available at any hardware store which directly conflicts with fact-2.
